text: Prior non-existence of an effect is without beginning and has an end, occurring before its production. Non-existence after the destruction and subsequent production of an effect has a beginning and is without end. Absolute non-existence is that which is defined by the absence of contact across the three periods of time, as in "a pot is not on the ground." Mutual non-existence is that which is defined by the relation of identity, as in "a pot is not a cloth."
